project_info.theme: 35mm black-and-white film triptych featuring an adult woman in a white dress

main_subject.description: An adult woman with naturally tousled shoulder-length hair, relaxed expressions, and natural skin texture.
main_subject.wardrobe: Fitted white short-sleeve dress with a simple square neckline and clean unbranded finish.
main_subject.pose: Three complementary poses across the triptych: standing with a side glance, smiling toward camera, and walking calmly on a city sidewalk.

composition_elements.framing: Three equal vertical panels arranged as a horizontal triptych: intimate portrait, medium portrait, and full-body street frame.
composition_elements.environment: Alternating pale studio wall, dark textured wall, and nighttime city sidewalk with soft practical lights; no readable text or logos.
composition_elements.focus: Consistent adult subject, expressive eyes, white dress texture, crisp flash shadow, and authentic dust and scratches across all panels.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Direct on-camera flash with hard graphic shadows in the first two panels and practical city lights in the final panel.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Raw, candid, playful, analog, and fashion-editorial.

technical_specs.camera: 35mm Kodak black-and-white film, direct flash, 35mm lens, f/4, 1/125 s, ISO 400
technical_specs.quality: Visible film grain, dust and scratches, lightly imperfect exposure, natural skin texture, and no digital retouching

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw analog 16:9 horizontal triptych of an adult woman photographed on Kodak 35mm black-and-white film. She has naturally tousled shoulder-length hair, natural skin texture, and wears a fitted white short-sleeve dress with a simple square neckline and no branding. Arrange three equal vertical panels: an intimate standing portrait with a side glance against a pale wall, a smiling medium portrait against a dark textured wall, and a calm full-body walk on a nighttime city sidewalk. Use direct on-camera flash with hard graphic shadows, practical city lights in the final panel, authentic 35mm grain, dust and scratches, lightly imperfect exposure, and no readable text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, over-smooth skin, excessive HDR, inconsistent face, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original subject. Optional wardrobe, environment, or film references may replace only their named element while preserving the three-panel structure, fitted white dress, direct flash, monochrome film treatment, and analog imperfections.
